Welcome to %1$s.
Your everyday shopping list works offline, without an account or a server. Start with the things you need and make it your own.
You can reopen this tour from Settings at any time.
Add it while you remember.
Tap the keyboard to type, or hold the microphone to speak. You can add several items at once.
Hold an item to edit its name, amount, category or shop, or set a repeat schedule.
Bring in a list or recipe.
Open the list menu to import a text note or recipe. Use the barcode button for packaged items. Review everything before adding.
Product lookup is optional. Photos of written lists use an optional image-capable model and are sent only when you request a read.
Shop, then save the memory.
Choose Start shopping and check items as you buy them. Finish shop saves checked items in History; unchecked items stay on your list.
The clock icon opens History. You can undo a finished shop if you closed it too soon.
After your first shops, find this shortcut above your list. Your frequent purchases come first: choose Add or Skip, one item at a time.
Up to 10 per round. Close whenever you like; additions stay. Undo last choice reverses your last action.
Your everyday, together.
Open Account in Settings and sign in through your browser. You can create an account there. Then use a list’s share icon to add people by name or email.
Sharing needs accounts on the same Usuals server. Your lists keep working offline and sync when connected.
